author: PictureFrames
body:
Hello everyone!

Due to my recent promotion to Community Administrator here on Avicus, I want to make your user experience as safe, fun, and entertaining as possible. I have been planning a ton with FluenZa_ about some new Community Events to host, changes in the way the Community will be ran, etc. However, I'd love a little bit of feedback! Please fill out this single answer survey http://strawpoll.me/3609892 and let me know how you think I'm doing. If your answer either meets the "Decent... Needs a little work." or is below that category, please let me know below what you feel I should improve on. Or if you'd like, no matter what you put for your answer on the poll; you can give me some feedback. As long as it's constructive, I'm okay with it.

Thanks a lot, everyone!

Regards, -Jake
